Name: Ehud, Son of Benjamin's Line
Summary: Head of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, whose sons removed them to Manahath.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:6: Head of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, whose sons removed them to Manahath.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ehud in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
